Privacy Policy

Beyond Policies We Practice Privacy

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, your personal information is more than details it’s a reflection of you. We protect it like it's our own, with full transparency and next-level security.

  • No Secrets Here: We’ll always tell you why we’re collecting your info before or right when we do it. No shady stuff.
  • Purpose-Driven Only: Every bit of info we collect has a mission. If it doesn’t serve a purpose, we don’t need it.
  • Your Info Stays Yours: We never hand over your personal data to third parties unless the law taps us on the shoulder.
  • We Ask First: We only collect your data with your full consent, fair and square.
  • Old News Gets Deleted: If it’s outdated, irrelevant, or incorrect, it’s out. We don’t hold on to useless info.
  • Fortress-Level Security: Your data is locked down tight with robust tech and strict access controls no breaches, no funny business.
